organizations.name: EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission)
organizations.eligibility: Workers at employers with 15+ employees (deadlines apply — usually 180 days)
organizations.what_they_help_with: Federal discrimination charges: race, sex, religion, national origin, disability, age, pregnancy, and retaliation. Free to file; no lawyer needed.

organizations.name: U.S. Dept. of Labor — Wage and Hour Division
organizations.eligibility: All workers — regardless of immigration status
organizations.what_they_help_with: Unpaid wages, unpaid overtime, minimum wage violations. Free complaints; they can recover money owed to you.

organizations.name: A Better Balance — Free Legal Helpline
organizations.what_they_help_with: Free legal help on pregnancy accommodations at work, family/medical leave, sick time, and caregiver discrimination.

organizations.name: National Employment Law Project
organizations.eligibility: Resource and referral hub for workers
organizations.what_they_help_with: Worker rights guides — wage theft, unemployment insurance, workplace safety — and referrals to worker centers.
